my_servers_subtitle: Manage servers owned by or accessible to the current account.
no_servers_hint: Claim an authorized server or request allocation from an administrator.
claim_server_desc: Claiming “{{name}}” assigns ownership to the current account and grants console, whitelist, and backup management permissions.
restart_confirm_players_one: One player is online. Restarting disconnects the player. Confirm restart?
restart_confirm_players_other: There are {{count}} players online. Restarting disconnects players. Confirm restart?
restart_confirm_unknown: The online player count could not be read. Players may still be connected. Restarting disconnects players. Confirm restart?
kill_warning: Force stop terminates the server process immediately, without saving or waiting for the termination grace period. Online players will be disconnected. Changes since the last save may be lost.
server_asleep_body: Starting the server creates a runtime instance. The live console connects automatically.
server_shutting_down_body: The Pod is terminating and the live console has disconnected. The server will enter the stopped state after termination.
server_waking_body: Startup duration depends on resource allocation and service initialization. The page updates the startup status automatically.
server_stopping_body: The server can be started again after shutdown completes.
server_failed_body: The automatic retry limit has been reached. Review startup logs and diagnostic information, resolve the fault, then select Retry start.
server_failed_retrying_body: The system will recreate the runtime instance and retry startup ({{used}} of {{max}} retries used). Select Retry start to initiate a new startup attempt immediately.
console_offline_body: The live console attaches automatically as soon as the server is running.
command_sent_stdin: Command sent. Check the console log for the result.
command_not_running: The server is not accepting console input. Start it before sending commands.
log_history_changed: The saved log changed after it was opened. Select Refresh log to reload its latest content.
log_history_failed: Saved log could not be loaded: {{reason}}
log_history_byte_limit: This page reached the 256 KiB size limit. Load earlier lines to read the preceding content.
log_ended_empty: Stream ended — reconnect to resume following the log.
players_link_desc: Manage the whitelist, online players, bans, and the wake list.
luckperms_link_desc: Manage player groups and fine-grained permission nodes.
backups_link_desc: View and restore world backups for this server.
files_link_desc: Browse and repair files in the world volume.
schedules_link_desc: Restart, back up or run commands at set times.
system_service_hint: Staff manage system services in Login & lobby.
players_not_yours_body: Only the owner or an admin can manage this server's players.
players_not_running_body: Player management runs over a live connection to the server. Wake it to manage the whitelist, online players, and bans.
access_player_invalid: Player names are 1–16 letters, digits or underscores.
access_whitelist_desc: When the whitelist is on, only listed players can join.
access_whitelist_empty_hint: Players added to the whitelist are permitted to join the server.
access_online_desc: Players currently connected to the server.
access_online_names_unavailable: {{count}} online, but the names could not be read.
access_online_names_unavailable_hint: See the raw server reply below for names.
access_ban_desc: Banning kicks a player and blocks them from rejoining. Expand to view the current ban list and pardon in one tap, or enter a full player ID to ban directly.
access_ban_confirm: Ban {{player}}? They'll be kicked and blocked from rejoining.
access_ban_empty_hint: The ban list displays banned players and provides pardon actions.
access_ban_load_error: Unable to load the ban list.
wake_list_desc: With the Wake list autostart policy, only the server owner, administrators, and players with wake permission can start a sleeping server. Players are added on first join. Rejoining does not restore revoked permission; it must be granted manually. The list is cleared when server ownership changes.
wake_list_inactive_owner: The current Owner only policy permits only the server owner and administrators to start a sleeping server. The wake list is inactive. Change the policy to Wake list in Edit Server Config to enable it.
wake_list_inactive_public: The current Public policy allows any player’s join to trigger startup. The wake list is inactive. The Wake list policy restricts startup to the server owner, administrators, and players with wake permission.
wake_list_load_error: Unable to load the wake list.
wake_list_empty_hint: Players are added to the list after their first join.
wake_list_revoke_aria: Take away {{player}}'s right to wake the server
wake_list_restore_aria: Allow {{player}} to wake the server again
wake_list_revoked: {{player}} can no longer wake the server.
create_server_desc: Select server software or a whitelisted image and a resource specification. The platform configures the server automatically. Raw cluster configuration editing is not provided.
create_server_name_invalid: Use 3–32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, with no hyphen at either end.
create_server_name_reserved: “{{name}}” is reserved by the platform. Use a different name.
create_server_image_failed: Unable to load the image list: {{reason}}
create_server_policy_owner: Owner only — wake from the panel
create_server_policy_public: Public — any player join wakes it
create_server_policy_allowlist: Wake list — previous players with wake permission can start the server
create_server_upload_failed: The server has been created, but the jar could not be uploaded: {{error}}. Retry the upload, or upload the jar in the server files later.
edit_server_desc: Configure display name, autostart policy, server software or image, memory, CPU, idle stop, crash restarts, and email notifications
edit_server_desc_long: Updating server spec. Fields left unchanged will retain their current values.
extra_ports_edit_hint: Add up to five TCP or UDP ports. Enter the internal port used by the plugin or mod; the platform assigns the external port. Saving applies the port configuration without restarting the game server.
extra_ports_direct_hint: Use the direct node address for plugins, mods and web maps. Cloudflare Tunnel does not carry these connections.
extra_ports_invalid: Enter whole ports from 1 to 65535 without repeating a port for the same protocol. TCP ports 25565 and 25575 are reserved.
extra_ports_pending: Applying port configuration. Direct addresses will update when it is applied.
extra_ports_address_unavailable: The direct address is not available yet.
edit_startup_hint: Only explicitly changed settings are saved. JVM options, startup arguments and environment variables apply at the next start or restart. Platform-managed environment variables and platform credentials are excluded.
edit_startup_java_flags_hint: Each entry is one option, without spaces or control characters, up to 1,024 UTF-8 bytes. Heap sizes are derived from Memory; -Xmx, -Xms, heap-size aliases and option files are not permitted.
edit_startup_args_hint: Each entry is one complete argument, up to 2,048 UTF-8 bytes. Spaces, line breaks and empty arguments are retained. Quotes are literal characters; arguments are not parsed as a shell command.
edit_startup_stop_commands_hint: Commands are attempted in order at the next normal stop or explicit restart, after attempting to save the world. Each command must be nonempty and on one line, up to 1,024 UTF-8 bytes. Failed commands do not prevent shutdown. Force stop does not run these commands.
edit_startup_env_hint: Names must be unique, start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits and underscores, up to 128 bytes. Values retain spaces and line breaks and may be empty, up to 4,096 UTF-8 bytes. Platform and runtime variables cannot be overridden. All advanced settings together are limited to 64 KiB of UTF-8 text.
edit_startup_restart_hint: The server is running or starting. Saving these startup settings does not restart it; restart the server to apply them.
edit_server_image_pinned_hint: The server is pinned to build {{id}}. Changes to the image tag do not update this server automatically. A new build is used only after the image configuration is changed.
edit_server_image_warning: Saving selects the build currently referenced by the image tag. Selecting the same tag again also selects its latest build. A Minecraft version change may upgrade the world on the next startup. Upgraded chunks are not compatible with older versions.
edit_server_image_confirm: I've backed up the world — change the image
luckperms_error_invalid_player: Invalid player name (1–16 chars: letters, digits, underscore)
luckperms_error_invalid_node: Invalid permission node (allowed: letters, digits, ., -, _, *, 1-64 chars)
luckperms_error_invalid_world: Invalid world context (allowed: letters, digits, -, _, 1-48 chars)
luckperms_desc: Manage player permission nodes and parent groups on this server (requires the LuckPerms plugin to be active).
luckperms_select_player_prompt: Please select an online player from the list, or enter a username to query.
luckperms_remove_perm_hint: Removal deletes the permission node in the specified world context regardless of its allow or deny value. Permission values apply only to additions.
luckperms_groups_unread: The player’s current groups could not be read. Enter a group name and select Remove Parent Group.
luckperms_perms_unread: The player’s current permission nodes could not be read. Enter the node name and applicable world context, then select Remove Permission.
luckperms_player_lookup: Look up a player by name
luckperms_no_reply: LuckPerms did not return query results through RCON, so current groups and permission nodes cannot be displayed. Additions and removals remain available. Name-based changes are reliable only for players who have joined since LuckPerms was installed. Changes for other names may not apply and may return no error.
luckperms_no_output: (the server returned no output — result unknown)
edit_server_cpu_invalid: The CPU limit must be greater than zero, expressed as cores (for example, 1 or 1.5) or millicores (for example, 500m).
edit_server_idle_hint: When the online count remains zero for the configured duration, the server stops automatically to release memory and CPU. Subsequent joins are handled according to the autostart policy.
edit_server_idle_unknown: The online player count could not be read. Idle shutdown is paused until player count retrieval resumes.
stop_confirm_players_one: One player is online. Shutdown sends an in-game notice and disconnects the player after 30 seconds. Confirm shutdown?
stop_confirm_players_other: There are {{count}} players online. Shutdown sends an in-game notice and disconnects players after 30 seconds. Confirm shutdown?
stop_confirm_unknown: The online player count could not be read. Players may still be connected. Confirm shutdown?
retire_card_desc: Releasing the server archives its world and makes the server available for other accounts to claim.
retire_card_desc_admin: Giving up archives the world and frees the server; deleting archives the world and removes the server, freeing its name and subdomain.
retire_step_stop: The server enters the shutdown process. Startup is unavailable until reclamation completes or the request is cancelled.
retire_step_release: At the next daily reclaim run the world is archived (kept 90 days by default), its storage deleted, and the server freed for someone else to claim.
retire_step_delete: The next daily reclaim run archives the world (retained for 90 days by default), then deletes world storage and the server record, releasing the name and subdomain.
retire_step_cancel_owner: The request can be cancelled from the console before reclamation runs. The server counts toward the account quota until reclamation completes.
retire_step_cancel_admin: An administrator can cancel from the console until the run.
retire_confirm_label: Type the server name to confirm:
retiring_body_release: Requested {{when}}. The next daily reclaim run archives the world, deletes world storage, and releases the server. Until completion, the server remains stopped, cannot be started, and counts toward the account quota.
retiring_body_delete: Requested {{when}}. The next daily reclaim run archives the world and deletes world storage and the server record. Until completion, the server remains stopped and cannot be started.
retiring_cancel_admin_only: An administrator asked for the deletion, so only an administrator can cancel it.
retiring_badge_hint: Release or deletion is pending until the next daily reclaim run. Startup is unavailable until completion or cancellation.
node_behind_hint: This node's felis binary or k3s version is behind the controller. Stop its servers, then choose "Update node" under Node operations.
migration_hint: The server stays stopped after migration. The source volume is retained; check the world before starting it.
migration_stop: Stop the server and wait for the game process to exit first.
migration_state_succeeded: Migration complete; start manually after inspection
migration_state_aborted: Migration abandoned; the server stays on its original node and can start normally
migration_abort_confirm: The server stays on its original node and becomes available again. The unfinished copy on the target node is deleted, and the pre-migration safety backup is kept as a restore point. The target node does not need to be online.
edit_system_desc: Adjust the name, image and resources. A replacement must retain the Felis login or menu plugin and match the proxy protocol. System services do not stop when idle.
log_starting_wait: Waiting for startup logs. The connection retries automatically while the server is starting.
startup_memory: Insufficient schedulable memory. Reduce this server’s memory allocation, stop other servers, or increase node capacity. Java has not started.
startup_hint: Startup includes resource scheduling, file preparation, and game initialization. Status updates automatically. When logs are unavailable, use the current stage and diagnostics to assess progress.
status_stale_detail: Cannot confirm the current server state. Last successful read: {{time}}. Retrying automatically. {{error}}
logs_unavailable_body: The container has not started producing logs. Check the startup diagnostics above; logs attach automatically once available.
startup_failed_hint: Check the image, configuration and memory using the reported error. Correct the problem before restarting the server.
emergency_stop_warning: When normal shutdown is unresponsive, set workload replicas directly to zero, bypassing the game process and Operator while retaining the normal termination grace period. World data is not deleted, but unsaved changes may be lost. Identity verification is required before execution.
emergency_stop_accepted: Stop intent has been saved and workload replicas set to zero. The system will continue checking Pod termination. Request acceptance does not confirm process termination.
emergency_stop_unknown: The result is unconfirmed. Stop intent may already be saved. Refresh status; if the control API is unreachable, use the host recovery steps.
host_recovery_hint: When the control API is offline, the panel cannot perform cluster operations. Run these commands on the deployment host to save stop intent, set replicas to zero, and inspect game Pods. Replace minecraft if the deployment uses a different namespace.
host_recovery_verify: If a Pod is terminating or its node is unreachable, process termination cannot be confirmed. Inspect the node and container runtime. Force-deleting a Pod is not evidence of process termination.
log_rcon_only: RCON connection lifecycle logs are hidden. Other logs will appear when available.
nodes_empty: No execution nodes were found. Check cluster connectivity and node enrollment.
node_fenced_hint: This node no longer receives work and its approval is withdrawn, so it holds no worlds. Once a worker is back online, approve it again under Node operations; once a controller is back online, return it to service here.
node_unfence_confirm: The fence is lifted and scheduling resumes on this controller. It has already rejoined etcd on its own; servers moved away by the failover stay on their new nodes, and their old world volumes remain on this controller's disk.
node_unfence_started: Started. Follow it in the task history under Node operations.
failover_hint: Brings the worlds of this lost node back on another node, each from its newest intact backup. The node is fenced first: it no longer receives work and its approval is withdrawn, so it must be approved again once it is back.
failover_loading: Loading the servers on this node…
failover_online: This node is online. Stop its servers and move them with Migrate world instead.
failover_no_servers: No user servers on this node need a failover.
failover_backup: Restores the backup from {{when}} ({{size}}); later changes are lost
failover_no_backup: No intact backup is available, so this server stays on the lost node
failover_no_targets: No online node can take these worlds right now.
failover_confirm_label: Type the node name {{node}} to confirm
failover_skipped_no_backup: {{name}}: no intact backup, stays on the lost node
failover_skipped_unknown_server: {{name}}: the panel has no record of this server, so it stays on the lost node
failover_fence_pending: The node could not be fenced yet ({{error}}). It is retried in the background, and no world is restored until the fence is in place.
failover_state_fencing: Waiting for the node to be fenced
failover_state_restoring: Restoring and verifying the backup on {{target}}
failover_state_failed: Failover failed; the server stays stopped
forwarding_description: How the proxy passes the player's identity to this server. Servers on 1.13 or newer use modern forwarding, signed with the proxy's secret; older backends behind ViaVersion need legacy forwarding.
forwarding_use_legacy_hint: The proxy applies the change at its next server-list refresh, within 15 seconds.
forwarding_risk: A legacy-forwarded server trusts any identity that reaches its port. Felis lets only the proxy reach game servers; do not expose this server's port in any other way.
software_type_paper_desc: High-performance plugin server, compatible with Bukkit and Spigot plugins
software_type_purpur_desc: Based on Paper, with more configurable gameplay options
software_type_quilt_desc: Mod loader compatible with Fabric mods
software_type_custom_desc: Upload a jar, or use one in the server files
software_version_failed: Unable to load the version list: {{reason}}
software_java_requirement: This game version requires Java {{version}} or later.
software_forwarding_velocity: The platform configures identity forwarding: players join through the proxy with their premium identity, keeping their UUID and skin.
software_forwarding_none: No identity forwarding component is available for this version. Players join with offline-mode UUIDs, and permissions and saves are recorded under those UUIDs.
software_jar_invalid: Enter a relative path inside the server directory that ends in .jar and is outside the .felis directory.
software_eula: I have read and accept the Minecraft End User License Agreement (EULA)
software_identity_velocity: Identity forwarded: players join with their premium identity.
software_identity_none: No identity forwarding component is available for this version. Players join with offline-mode UUIDs.
software_identity_none_custom: The platform does not configure identity forwarding for a custom jar. Players join with offline-mode UUIDs. To use premium identities, install and configure Velocity forwarding on the server.
edit_owner_desc: Configure display name, autostart policy, server software, memory, CPU, idle stop, crash restarts, and email notifications
edit_server_software_warning: After a software or game version change, the next startup opens the world with the new version. Upgraded chunks are not compatible with older versions. The platform removes the old version's server files; the world, configuration and plugins are kept.
edit_server_software_confirm: I've backed up the world — change the software
self_create_desc: Select server software and a resource specification. The server belongs to this account, and its resources count toward the quota.
self_create_quota_full: The server quota is fully used. New servers cannot be created.
create_server_memory_hint: The memory limit in GiB; decimals such as 1.5 are allowed. The JVM heap is sized from it.
create_server_memory_hint_left: In GiB; decimals are allowed. {{left}} GiB of the quota is left.
create_server_memory_invalid: Enter a number of at least 1, in GiB.
create_server_storage_hint: The world volume size in whole GiB. It cannot be changed after creation.
create_server_storage_hint_left: In whole GiB; it cannot be changed after creation. {{left}} GiB of the quota is left.
create_server_storage_invalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1, in GiB.
create_server_over_quota: This exceeds the quota; {{left}} GiB of it is left.
edit_server_storage_fixed: The world volume size is set at creation and cannot be changed.
software_jar_running: The server is running, so its files cannot be read or uploaded to. Stop it to pick a jar from its files or upload one.
software_jar_none: There is no jar in the server's root folder. Upload one, or enter the path of a jar elsewhere.
software_jar_none_path: There is no jar in the server's root folder. Enter the path of the jar.
software_jar_replaces: A file of this name is already in the server; saving replaces it.
software_jar_move_hint: A path relative to the server's root folder, such as pack/server.jar. The folders in it are created.
software_jar_drop: Drag a jar here, or click to choose a file
software_jar_drop_hint_create: Uploaded to the server's root folder once the server is created.
software_jar_drop_hint_save: Uploaded to the server's root folder on save.
software_jar_path_hint: Where the jar is in the server files, relative to the root folder, such as server.jar or pack/server.jar. If the jar has not been uploaded, the server fails to start and says so.
edit_server_resume_hint: When the host goes down through a power loss or a restart, a server that was running starts again once the host is back.
edit_server_crash_restart_hint: Starts the server again when its process exits unexpectedly or stops responding.
edit_server_crash_max_hint: After more crashes in a row than this, the server stops and must be started by hand. The count starts over after an hour without a crash.
edit_server_crash_max_invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
edit_server_crash_off_hint: When its process exits, the server stays stopped until it is started by hand.
edit_server_notify_problems_hint: Crashes, failed starts, host restarts and disk quota warnings.
edit_server_notify_hint: Sent to the verified email of the server's owner; for an unclaimed server, to the platform owners. The platform needs a mail relay.
crash_cause_oom: Out of memory; the process was killed
crash_cause_clean: The process exited on its own (exit code 0)
event_stopped_idle: Stopped on its own with nobody online
event_stopped_host: Stayed stopped after a host restart
event_stopped_disk: Stopped after reaching the disk quota
event_disk_warning: Disk usage reached 90% of the quota
event_host_resume: The host restarted; the server resumed
event_host_stop: The host restarted; the server stayed stopped as set
event_start_failed: Failed to start; automatic retries spent
event_crashed_stop_limit: {{cause}}; crash {{n}} in a row is over the limit, so the server stopped
event_crashed_stop_off: {{cause}}; restart after a crash is off, so the server stopped
autostop_crash_limit_title: The server kept crashing and is no longer restarted
autostop_crash_limit_body: It crashed more often in a row within an hour than its limit of {{max}} restarts. Latest: {{cause}}, {{when}}.
autostop_crashed_title: The server stopped after a crash
autostop_crashed_body: Restart after a crash is off for this server. Latest: {{cause}}, {{when}}.
autostop_host_title: The server did not resume after a host restart
autostop_disk_title: The server stopped after reaching its disk quota
autostop_disk_body: Disk usage reached the quota {{when}}. The platform requested a normal shutdown.
autostop_disk_next: The disk quota no longer blocks starting this server. Select Wake when needed.
autostop_host_body: The host restarted {{when}}, for example after a power loss. This server has resuming after a host restart turned off, so it stayed stopped.
autostop_crash_next: Check the log for the cause, then select Wake once it is fixed. Players joining do not wake this server.
autostop_host_next: Select Wake when the server is needed; a player joining also wakes it under its autostart policy.
recent_crashes: Crashed {{n}} times in a row within the last hour and was restarted each time (limit {{max}}). Latest: {{cause}}, {{when}}.
recent_crashes_any: Crashed {{n}} times in a row within the last hour. Latest: {{cause}}, {{when}}.
usage_window: CPU and memory · Every 15 seconds · Last hour
usage_cpu_curve: CPU usage over the last hour
usage_memory_curve: Memory usage over the last hour
usage_cpu_basis: CPU percentages use the server limit; unlimited CPU is shown in millicores. Memory is the working set.
usage_unavailable: Current metrics are unavailable. Values update automatically when sampling resumes.
usage_stopped: The server is not running. The last hour of history is retained.
disk_stale: Current disk usage is unavailable. Last successful sample:
disk_warning: The last disk sample is at least 90% of the quota. At 100%, the platform stops the server and blocks starts.
disk_full_blocked: The disk quota blocks starting and restarting. A fresh sample below the quota is required to remove this restriction.
extensions_link_desc: View installed JAR files, manage their enabled state and open their configuration directories.
extensions_not_yours_body: Only the server owner or an admin can manage its plugins and mods.
extensions_restart_hint: Uploads, enabling, disabling and deletion take effect after the server restarts.
extensions_wait: Wait for the current file operation or server transition to finish before modifying plugins and mods.
extensions_jar_required: Select only files with the .jar extension.
extensions_empty_hint: Upload JAR files into plugins/ or mods/ to install plugins and mods.
extensions_delete_body: The JAR file will be permanently deleted. Configuration files are retained. Running servers apply the change after restart.
extensions_truncated: Some JAR files are omitted because the listing limit was reached. Use file management to inspect other files.
